featured_reviews.name: Dr Amala
featured_reviews.review_text: This popular sweet cafe serves both desserts n savouries in unique combinations. We tried their panipuri with both avocado n aloo fillings n pav bhaji porter house rolls with amazing chaas butter along with mango + passion fruit lassi n gulab jamun. featured_reviews.name: The explorer
featured_reviews.review_text: We've been to Bombay sweet shop multiple times since their opening at phoenix palladium mall and always leave happy & content from their outlet. The staff are so sweet, warm. attentive,helpful and quick that really enriches our experience there. They have a laddoo game near the entrance which entertains the kids very much. There's also a soft serve given after crossing some cut off points in the game. It engages kids and adults alike,I must say. They have quite a few tables and hence the place is almost full. Luckily they serve really fast and we still got a table after a 10-15min wait time. Another positive is that it's open till midnight to stop by for a quick dessert too. We had tried their gulab jamun Churros, chilli cheese toast pav bhaji porter rolls, arbi tuk chat, OG pind chole bhature,rajma galouti wrap, bhutte ka khees served with khakhra, avo papdi chat, cappuccino,hot chocolate, raspberry matcha falooda, strawberry granola sundae, jalebi waffle, strawberry softserve and caramel icecream so far. Most of them were really good especially highlighting their chilli cheese toast,pav bhaji porter rolls, softserves, icecreams,sundae,coffees and jalebi waffle. Their salted caramel icecream served with their chocolate caramel barks is a must try. Personally found churros,hot chocolate to be too sweet for my liking. They do have a strawberry special menu for this season which is attached in the pics below. One cannot miss 'Bombay Sweet Shop' while visiting Phoenix palladium mall.

featured_reviews.name: Ragini Elf Gongo
featured_reviews.review_text:
I thought I couldn’t be more impressed by the Hunger Inc team… but today proved me wrong again!

I walked in with so many shopping bags, sweaty and awkward, because every table looked taken and my hands were hurting. Their team, not one but multiple people, instantly came forward to help with my bags and offered me a high seating table. Before anything else, he brought me a glass of water. I felt so cared for. And as a former hotelier, I can say this with confidence, this wasn’t an SOP, this was genuine hospitality.

Even during a busy service, the team took time to explain the dishes, check on me, and recommend what to try next.

I’ve always been a fan of Hunger Inc… and your success honestly feels personal to me.

Thank you!✨

featured_reviews.name: Amee Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bombay Sweet Shop hits a nerve.

Make mithai great again.
A line on a wall.
A promise on a plate.

The space pulls you back to Bombay sweet marts.
Metal tables with GM weight markers pressed into them.
The same tools once used to weigh barfis and pedas by hand.
You notice.
You pause.

Chit Chat on one side.
All wells that ends well on another.
Details matter here.

The food delivers.
Matar kachori with crisp bite and clean spice.
Lychee kombucha with balance and lift.
Both work together.

This works as a Starbucks replacement.
You sit.
You snack.
You stay longer.

In a world full of cupcakes be a laddo.
Bombay Sweet Shop lives by it.

featured_reviews.name: SALONI NAGWEKAR
featured_reviews.review_text: I worked with Nicole to create personalized mithai boxes for my wedding announcement, and the entire experience was exceptional. She is incredibly detail-oriented and truly committed to making everything perfect. From helping me choose the design to patiently answering all my questions, and even ensuring every item in the box was arranged exactly how I envisioned, she went above and beyond at every step. She made this special part of my wedding celebrations feel seamless and memorable. Thank you and much love to Bombay Sweet Shop and Nicole!!

featured_reviews.name: Nisrin Abdul Kadir
featured_reviews.review_text: Love your bark butterscotch but had a bad  experience when my cousin ordered it for me via zomato. Firstly the bill was 1768inr and zomato charged me 1828inr. The delivery person was rude because he did not have change and it took me sometime to get change. I would sincerely suggest not to buy via zomato.

featured_reviews.name: Suhasini Sudan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Love their ambience, their decorations, and their trial sweet and savoury snacks. Love their unique twist on fusion Indo-western desserts and snacks. Their Avo Papdi chaat is delicious and so are their Gulab Jamun churros, their Rasgulla Tiramisu and their special strawberry menu. Their thick hot chocolate with the special cookie is also a personal favourite. I also love their chocolate barks, especially the strawberry chocolate one.

Has become such a stable, me and my friends go there practically every week. Amazing for a treat.

featured_reviews.name: Akarsh Kavuttan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Finally had the opportunity to visit the famous Bombay Sweet Shop!

Although I couldn’t have much as I had already ordered a bunch of sweets earlier on the occasion of Women’s Day!

Nevertheless the vibe was fantastic! The interiors were also fantastic!

featured_reviews.name: Priya pokhare
featured_reviews.review_text: Mithais are more than just good packaging and presentation. People may be all impressed with BSS but honestly I was a bit underwhelmed. I have gifted friends and family with their items . But they are overdoing the fusion stuff , which I guess is the point but they are losing their vision. I also think they do not use good quality chocolate for their brittle and fudge. The fudge tastes flat and nothing of chocolate. The only decent thing maybe the chocolate butter cookies . I would like to like them but they need to make it make sense for the price I pay .

featured_reviews.name: Anasuya Roshan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had these delivered in Mumbai and brought over to Malaysia within 24hrs. They lasted the entire journey intact and lip smacking good!

I strongly recommend the Cheat Box, Assorted Mithai Box and Kalakand (any flavour of the Kalakand if you can get your hands on some). Bite-sized portions, provided you exercise control, which is impossible I'd say. Their namkeens are addictive, those should come with warning labels. All edibles are have allergens labelled on their packaging; it simplifies matters for those who have restrictive diets.

None of the sweets are overly sweet despite being 'sweets'. I'm not sure how to explain the irony of that sentence, but those who have an indulgent sweet tooth AND a hawk's eye on their calorie intake, you know what I mean.

Always a good experience shopping from you!

featured_reviews.name: Sassinator
featured_reviews.review_text: BSS is extraordinary!! We were introduced to the store thru an equally amazing 5 Senses Tour. We HAD to go back!! The service and the sweets were OFF THE CHARTS!! We even brought our Uber driver in to treat him to their delicious ice cream!!

featured_reviews.name: Amruta S
featured_reviews.review_text: Don’t buy from them online! I placed an online order in time for Diwali. The order was well Packaged but had an important missing item - the kaju katli burfi. Their customer service does not exist! Neither on WhatsApp, email or phone. Best to go to the store and get what you pay for instead of paying for missed items and chasing them with no result.
